question: In a certain code language, 'ZEPHYR' is coded as 'IIYLHV' and 'SCHIZY' is coded as 'BGQMIC'. What is the code for 'ZINCKY' in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Alternately (9) and (4) are added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​​So,

 
• 'ZEPHYR' is coded as 'IIYLHV'
